status: Root cause and paired control verified; exact bootstrap diagnostic accepted. No Qore package or OBS policy workaround applied.
root_cause: Inherited SUSE build configuration explicitly ignores polkit-default-privs:polkit. The polkit-default-privs RPM Requires(pre): polkit, whose rules directory is therefore absent in the reduced build root. Its post script invokes chkstat-polkit, which opens /etc/polkit-1/rules.d/90-default-privs.rules.new without creating its parent and exits 2. This occurs while OBS installs distribution build inputs, before Qore compilation or tests.
scope: Only the polkit-default-privs post script failure with the exact missing rules.d path in Leap OBS build-root bootstrap; no other scriptlet failures, no installed user environment failures.

command:
set -eu
test ! -d /etc/polkit-1/rules.d
set +e
perl /source/src/chkstat-polkit -set /source/profiles/standard > /tmp/negative.log 2>&1
status=$?
set -e
cat /tmp/negative.log
test "$status" = 2
grep -Fx "can't open /etc/polkit-1/rules.d/90-default-privs.rules.new: No such file or directory" /tmp/negative.log
# Positive control supplies the directory owned by the omitted polkit dependency.
mkdir -p /etc/polkit-1/rules.d
perl /source/src/chkstat-polkit -set /source/profiles/standard
test -s /etc/polkit-1/rules.d/90-default-privs.rules
grep -q 'polkit.addRule' /etc/polkit-1/rules.d/90-default-privs.rules
printf 'negative exit=%s; positive exit=0; generated rules verified\n' "$status"

approval: Approved by the user on 2026-10-06: Allow this exact bootstrap diagnostic.
